name: Rattlesnake Hills

climate: Merlot, Riesling, Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Young Sangiovese plantings here have given spicy, tart cherry wines with anise, red currant and tobacco leaf.

blurb.text: A Washington AVA in Yakima Valley, within the Columbia Valley, on a ridge where the AVA rises to 3,085 feet. Merlot is the most planted grape, followed by Riesling and Cabernet Sauvignon.
